searchText: I posted a thread regarding the libp2p TLS 1.3 protocol. It provides a detailed explanation of how the TLS protocol works, along with my merged PR for the full implementation of the TLS 1.3 protocol for Nethermind’s .NET libp2p. Have a look through it: https://x.com/0xrosetteeee/status/1838580914965876931?s=46
